info.name: Echo API — Check-in & Savouring
info.description:
Tests for the check-in and savouring journals: libraries, capture flow, AI conversation, savouring closing, crisis tiers, resume, list and delete.

=== SETUP ===
1. Run `alembic upgrade head` once.
2. Start the server. For folders 03–05 the AI must work (Azure key in .env) or set LLM_MOCK=true (then the Roman Urdu model-stage test in 05 fails, as expected).
3. Set seedEmail / seedPassword to an account that has finished onboarding — ideally a TEST account, because folder 05 creates crisis detection records.
4. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner, or one by one). Later folders use ids saved by earlier ones.

Each request's description says what the expected output is, and each has a saved example response (open the request → Examples) from a real run against gpt-4.1-mini. AI wording will differ on your run; the tests only check structure and rules, not exact wording.

Re-running: the "Danger again" test expects the abbreviated variant; on a fresh account the first danger response is full, the second abbreviated.
